items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He is playing in the Eureka band. ... Cookshop Sun is the one I was telling you about. ... That's the first job I went on.

ctx.x: Kind of tall, yeah. He is playing drums. Yeah, he's playing in the Eureka band.

Eureka band. I seen him in the Connors because I oughta ever grow up there. Either of me be playing a parade. Yeah, I was mixed up. Cookshop, I mean, Cookshop Sun is the one I was telling you about. He had the kazoo. He had the kazoo. That's the first job I went on. He played dance work then too.
He had a whole drum set playing.
